children: Jinko Solar's margins should recover gradually as it sells more premium panels and reduces sales to low-price orders, Citi analyst Air Ma says in a note. The Chinese manufacturer's gross margin rose to 6.0% in 3Q from 3.4% in 1H, Ma says. A potential solar-demand recovery in 2Q 2027 is the sector's key catalyst. Citi widens its 2026 net loss forecast by 2.6 times to 4.1 billion yuan on lower sales and currency losses. It cuts its target price to 4.50 yuan from 7.50 yuan, also to reflect a higher cost of capital, but maintains a buy. Shares are down 1.65% at 3.58 yuan. (venkat.pr@wsj.com)
